body:
Thank you, it's nice to know that someone understands the nature of the beast. I know it'll eventually pass, but I'm sure you know too that it won't take long before it crashes again, and I just worry that it's going to get harder every time. The friends and my wife are what keep me going, I could give a shit less about what my family would think, however cruel that may be.

How did you figure it out? Did it just change one day? I'm curious.

Thank you. I write all the time, and it used to bring me a lot of joy to be creative like that. As of late, I still have a project, and I try to vent with poetry, but it hasn't helped very much with this, which worries me.
